0022600008.text: The Knicks, who are 0-1 and 9th in the East after a loss, make their second trip of the 2026-27 season to Boston, where the Celtics are also 0-1 and 12th in the East. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Knicks won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 112-106 victory in New York on April 9, 2026. Boston will be without Devin Carter, who is out with an illness.
